meta.name: shadcn
meta.description: Manages shadcn components and projects — adding, searching, fixing, debugging, styling, and composing UI, including chat interfaces. Provides project context, component docs, and usage examples. Applies when working with shadcn/ui, component registries, presets, --preset codes, or any project with a components.json file. Also triggers for "shadcn init", "create an app with --preset", or "switch to --preset".

copy.tagline: 添加、修复、调整界面组件,快速搭建标准化的前端页面。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在搭建网页界面,需要反复添加和调整现成的界面组件。
copy.tagline_en: Add, fix, and style UI components to streamline building frontend pages.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build web interfaces and want to easily manage and adjust UI components.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按 shadcn/ui 规范帮你管理和修改组件:添加、搜索、更新组件,查看组件文档,修复错误写法,并处理 --preset 预设。它会先读项目配置,再调用 npx shadcn@latest 等命令,写出的代码符合组件库约定。
howto.when: 当项目带有 components.json,且你在处理 shadcn/ui 组件、注册中心或 --preset 预设等时触发;也适用于要求执行 'shadcn init' 等 CLI 操作的时候。

say.text: 先查看项目当前信息,再添加一个 Button 组件。
say.note: 他会先跑 info,再通过 add 安装组件。

say.text: 用 npx shadcn@latest search 找个头像组件。
say.note: 到官方或社区注册中心检索结果。

say.text: 检查我加的 Select 是否按规定放进 SelectGroup。
say.note: 读取源码并修正组件结构。

howto.what_en: Claude manages shadcn components and projects: adds, searches, updates/fixes components, fetches docs, handles presets. It reads the project config, runs commands like npx shadcn@latest, and outputs shadcn-conformant code.
howto.when_en: It applies when the project has a components.json and you're working with shadcn/ui, component registries, or --preset presets — including requests like 'shadcn init' and other CLI operations.

say_en.text: Check the project state first, then add a Button component.
say_en.note: Runs info, then installs with add.

say_en.text: Use npx shadcn@latest search to find an avatar component.
Check whether my added Select is inside a SelectGroup as required.
say_en.note: Reads the source and fixes the structure.
